title: Faden, Plan of the operations of General Washington against the King's troops in New Jersey (1777)
fit: {"method": "rubber-sheet: warped (thin-plate spline) so 12 towns and crossings fall on their real places", "points": 12, "misfit_m": 0, "m_per_px": 7}
note: Faden's engraving, published in London in April 1777, is out of proportion: against the ground it is about 45% too narrow one way, and laid down whole its towns are 1 to 7 km from where they are. So this view stretches it smoothly so 12 towns and crossings fall on their real places and the units line up with it; lettering and roads are bent as a result, most in the east. The 1:1 button shows the engraving as printed, unstretched and at full detail, with the units placed on it by the same fit.
